result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 101 is a small Export-dialog fix: remove a 16 px gap under the dialog's footer, give the progress bar spoken text, and tidy one Enter-guard line.

**Round 100 result:** C passed it in the browser with 0 bugs, and root published it as `17d944d`. That closes the held-Enter preview bug (B-R98-H1) and the doc 087 status line (GATE99-S1). Those two closures are my only backlog changes from C's results. SRW-12 goes back to **მოწმდება**; only the Tech Lead's manual checks remain.

**Why this next:** C has no open bugs. The Export dialog file was kept frozen until the held-Enter fixes were done, and they now are. I measured the gap in Chromium:
- **1280×720:** 16 px below the footer when the dialog is scrolled to the bottom.
- **1440×900:** 16 px every time the dialog opens, with no scrolling.
- **With the fix applied at runtime:** 0 px at both sizes.

**Round 101 task (`current-task.md`, D-29z66):**
- **Code (A):** all in `ArrangementExportDialog.tsx`, only on four lines/elements:
  - the dialog body gets `pb-0` (the shared `Modal.tsx` is protected);
  - the footer padding becomes `py-4`;
  - the progress bar gets `aria-valuetext` equal to the visible progress label, with no live region;
  - the Close-button guard changes from `event.repeat === true` to `event.repeat`, which behaves the same.
- **Tests:** three new tests (FS1, FV1, FV2) added to the end of the existing `export-dialog-footer.test.tsx`; no new test file. FS1 only checks class names, and the task says so: the gap itself is proven by C's browser rows. A must show FS1 and FV1 fail on the old code, and run four mutations.
- **Docs:** doc 088's status line, plus a new doc 089.
- **Baseline:** `17d944d`, clean tree, 532 frozen files verified. Expected end state is 3 modified files plus 1 new doc.
- **C checks:**
  - STRIP-1280 and STRIP-1440: gap 0 ± 1 px, scrolling with the mouse wheel only;
  - render, focus and held-Enter-on-Close regressions;
  - the spoken progress text in every phase, including MP3 loading;
  - a real WAV export, no protected network calls, no hydration errors;
  - the anonymous route check run alone, the test review, and the source-unchanged check.
- **Space on the preview button:** C also confirms one observation the gate 100 reviewer asked for. When the ▶ preview button has focus, Space starts the transport once and never clicks the preview button. That is an observation by me so far, so it stays open until C sees the same.

**Kept open, not deferred:**
- A-R88 #1–#3 (how the dialog scrolls when a control gets focus) get their own round.
- GATE89-S3 and the other Lows, R21-I2, SRW-21-PREMOUNT and the mount, T12 and VISUAL-A-OBSIDIAN stay in order.
- Only the SRW-21 mount waits on an outside release (the auth owner), so this is not BLOCKED.

**Regression round:** not due yet. The last one is recorded as 2026-10-21 and today is 2026-10-23; the rule needs 3 days. The next B planning on or after 2026-10-24 is the regression round.

**Architecture:** I added addendum (m) to the checkpoint request. After round 101, root is asked for one bounded, read-only frontend-architect checkpoint on the shared Enter-guard helper and the test-harness copies. It blocks nothing.

**Advisor:** available, called twice. The second call caught a wrong file count in the task's test list (21 instead of 13); I corrected it.

The store tree is still clean at `17d944d`, and the frozen list still verifies.
